===Edit War===
I'm being vehement about those edits staying because 1, they do accurately convey her personality, and 2, they're not my edits, and this guy just showed up and started deleting accurate information. If he had edited it to make it more clear, I would have been fine with that, but he just showed up and deleted everything he didn't like. 

I'm not saying that the description of her is perfect, but the information in it is correct even if there are some opinions. If he reworked it to be a little less biased, that would be fine, but he seems to believe that the only solution is the deletion of correct information. I can't support that, so I keep undoing his edits.
